plugins.name: statutory-reporting
plugins.description: Generate statutory financial statements from Trial Balances. Supports Ind AS (India), IFRS, Indian GAAP, and US GAAP. Classifies accounts, builds Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow Statement, Changes in Equity, and Notes to Accounts following Schedule III / IAS 1 formats. Built by JupiteX Technologies — Chartered Accountants and AI architects.

skills.name: disclosure-notes
skills.description: Generate notes to financial statements following Ind AS, IFRS, or US GAAP requirements. Covers narrative notes (reporting entity, basis of preparation, accounting policies) and numerical notes (PPE schedule, trade receivable ageing, financial ratios). Use when the user asks to "add notes", "draft disclosures", "write accounting policies", "generate Note 1", "trade receivable ageing", "financial ratios", "related party note", or when building notes to accounts for statutory financial statements.
headings: Notes to Financial Statements — Disclosure Generator
Numerical Notes — Balance Sheet (from TB data)
Disclosure Notes (mix of auto and user input)
Trade Payable Ageing (MCA 2021 — Mandatory, MSME split)

skills.name: financial-statements
skills.description: Generate complete statutory financial statements in Excel from a classified Trial Balance. Produces Balance Sheet, Statement of Profit and Loss, Cash Flow Statement (indirect method), and Statement of Changes in Equity following Schedule III Division II (Ind AS), IAS 1 (IFRS), or US GAAP format. Use when the user has a TB or Mapping table and wants face sheets with formulas. Triggers on "generate financial statements", "build balance sheet", "create P&L", "cash flow statement", "financial statements from TB", "Schedule III", "IAS 1 format", or "statutory financials".
headings: Balance Sheet — Ind AS (Schedule III Division II)
Statement of Profit and Loss — Ind AS

skills.name: forensic-review
skills.description: Review financial statements for errors, inconsistencies, red flags, and compliance issues. Use this skill when the user asks to "check", "review", "audit", "verify", or "validate" financial statements, or when asked to find errors in a Balance Sheet, P&L, or workbook. Also triggers on "BS not balancing", "balance sheet difference", "why doesn't it tally", "reconciliation", or "forensic analysis".
headings: Check 3: CFS Closing Cash = BS Cash
Check 4: Note Totals = Face Sheet References
Forensic Red Flags (for published financial statements)

skills.name: tb-classification
skills.description: Classify Trial Balance accounts into statutory financial statement line items. Use this skill when the user has a Trial Balance (from Tally, Zoho, QuickBooks, Xero, SAP, or any Excel) and needs accounts classified into Balance Sheet and P&L categories following Schedule III (Ind AS), IAS 1 (IFRS), or US GAAP format. Triggers on "classify trial balance", "classify TB", "map accounts", "Schedule III", "chart of accounts mapping", "GL classification", or when a spreadsheet contains typical TB columns (account name, debit, credit).
headings: Trial Balance Classification for Statutory Financial Statements
Note: use wildcard for sub-categories with detail suffixes

commands.name: financials
commands.description: Generate statutory financial statements from a Trial Balance. Classifies accounts, builds BS, P&L, CFS, SOCIE, and Notes following Schedule III (Ind AS), IAS 1 (IFRS), Indian GAAP, or US GAAP format.

commands.name: review-financials
commands.description: Review financial statements for errors, inconsistencies, and compliance issues. Checks BS balance, formula integrity, cross-references, sign conventions, and common mistakes.
